meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容做成分页演示文稿,支持分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,能直接翻页讲解。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把想法变成一份可现场翻页讲解、带备注的演示文稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into a deck you can present page by page with notes.

howto.what: Claude 会为你编写 HyperFrames 幻灯片：离散页面、片段揭示、热点分支、带备注的演讲者模式，也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可导航播放的 deck，不是导出的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片（slideshow）时直接开始；若请求是「presentation」「pitch deck」或转换现有页面等相邻说法，它会先向你确认再开始编写。

say.text: 把这份 BRIEF.md 做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片。
say.note: 读取已确认的意图并开始编排。

say.text: 把这个页面转成幻灯片，保留原来的动效和媒体。
say.note: 按源页面搬运视觉与交互行为。

say.text: 用 present 播放这个 deck，打开演讲者备注。
say.note: 进入播放器，逐页导航并显示备注。

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow for you: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode with speaker notes, and conversion of an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an exported MP4.
howto.when_en: It starts when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. If the request is an adjacent one such as a presentation, pitch deck, or page conversion, it confirms with you first before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this BRIEF.md into a HyperFrames slideshow.
say_en.note: Reads the confirmed intent and starts authoring.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a deck, keeping its motion and media.
say_en.note: Ports the source visuals and interactions.

say_en.text: Play this deck with presenter mode and speaker notes.
say_en.note: Opens the player for slide-by-slide navigation.
